review:
An Egyptian book slot with a great retrigger twist. Ten lines, and the book substitutes for anything and pays anywhere.

Three or more scatters give 10 free spins with a random expanding symbol. Every retrigger adds another expanding symbol, up to nine, and retriggers are unlimited – so a long bonus gets more and more stacked as it goes. Very high volatility and a 7,500x max. The downside is a lower 94.94% RTP, so it's best enjoyed in demo.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
